full_prompt_en: A square Fauvist-style landscape painting shows a small group of white houses with red roofs beside a still lake, under a turbulent blue and cream sky. The sky fills the upper third in broad slashing strokes of navy, slate, chalk white, and pale peach. A solid cobalt-blue ridge runs behind the houses across the middle distance. On the opposite shore, tall dark cypress-like trees cluster around the buildings, their near-black green silhouettes reaching into the light sky. Several small houses sit from the left edge to the center-right, their white walls lit by strong yellow and cream marks and their roofs colored in vivid red-brown. The bank slopes from center toward the lower right in intense orange, saffron, and green patches. A narrow pale track cuts through the warm ground toward a small white house on the right. The lake occupies most of the lower left and center, its deep blue surface broken by vertical reflections of the white walls, red roofs, dark trees, and sky. Reflected shapes remain jagged and brushy rather than mirror-perfect. In the lower right, a dark green bank makes a diagonal wedge against the water. The whole image is built from thick, energetic strokes, with an especially rough edge along the cloud bank and shoreline. Light is dramatic but not tied to a single visible sun; bright pale cloud and yellow banks seem to glow against the blue ridge and dark trees. Shadows are colored in teal, violet-blue, and black-green rather than neutral gray. There is no readable text. The overall composition is compact and vivid, with hot land colors and bright walls set between a restless dark sky and cool reflective water.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形、带野兽派气息的风景绘画呈现一组白墙红顶小屋立在静湖边，上方是翻动的蓝白天空。天空占据上方三分之一，由海蓝、石板色、粉笔白及浅桃色的宽阔斜扫笔触组成。一道结实的钴蓝山脊横贯屋后中远景。对岸，高耸的深色柏树状树木聚在房屋周围，近黑绿色剪影伸入亮天空。从左缘到中央偏右散落几栋小屋，白墙由强烈黄色与奶油色笔痕照亮，屋顶呈鲜红棕色。岸坡从中央向右下延伸，铺满浓橘、藏红花黄和绿色片。一条狭窄浅色小径切过暖色地面，通向右边的小白屋。湖水占据左下和中央大部，深蓝水面被白墙、红顶、暗树与天空的竖向倒影打断。反光形状参差且充满笔触，而非完美镜面。右下角深绿河岸在水边切出一道斜楔。整幅图由厚实、有力的笔触构成，云缘与岸线尤其粗犷。光戏剧化却没有单一可见太阳；明亮浅云与黄色岸地在蓝山脊和暗树前似乎发亮。阴影呈青绿、紫蓝和黑绿，而非中性灰。画中没有可读文字。整体构图紧凑鲜艳，炽热地色与亮墙夹在不安的暗天空和冷反光水面之间。
style_prompt_en: This vigorous oil-paint treatment relies on thick directional strokes, saturated complementary color, and emphatic dark silhouettes. Cobalt, navy, teal, and black-green oppose cadmium yellow, orange, red-brown, and chalky cream in broad irregular patches. Edges are broken and rough, with strokes visibly following large horizontal bands, upward accents, and diagonal foreground wedges. Reflections and shadows are colored rather than neutrally graded, so depth is energetic and somewhat flattened. Bright planes glow against deep cool masses without smooth blending. Repeated vertical marks interrupt wide blue areas, while a warm diagonal carries attention through the center. The overall effect is bold, tactile, and rhythmically charged.
style_prompt_zh: 这种有力油画处理依靠厚实方向笔触、饱和互补色与强调的深色剪影。钴蓝、海蓝、青绿及黑绿，以宽放不规则色片对抗镉黄、橘、红棕和粉笔般奶油色。边缘断裂粗糙，笔触明显顺着大型水平带、向上强调和前景斜楔运行。倒影与阴影通过色彩表现，而非中性明暗渐层，纵深因而有活力且略趋平面。明亮平面在深冷色大块前发光，没有平滑调匀。重复竖痕打断宽阔蓝色区，一道暖色斜线带注意穿过中央。整体效果粗壮、有触感，节奏强烈。
theme_en: Bright houses and dark trees reflected in a lake
theme_zh: 明亮房屋与深色树木倒映湖面
name: Maurice de Vlaminck
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
